title: Katt Williams Recalls Shaquille O'Neal Almost Killing Him on Jet Ski
text:
Katt Williams Recalls Shaquille O'Neal Almost Killing Him on Jet Ski Search sneakers, brands, or styles... Sign In SHOP STYLE SNEAKERS MUSIC SPORTS POP CULTURE BETS COVER STORIES VERZUZ WATCH COMMUNITY Pop Culture Katt Williams Recalls Shaquille O'Neal Almost Killing Him on Jet Ski
 By Will Lavin November 13, 2026 Comments Comment Save Share Comments Comments YouTube/Listen & Laugh | Paras Griffin/Getty Images Key Takeaways
 Katt Williams recalled a terrifying jet ski collision with Shaquille O'Neal on Listen & Laugh , saying Shaq hit his jet ski while attempting a splash maneuver at roughly 40 mph. 
 Williams said the crash launched him into the air and left him panicking when he couldn’t spot Shaq in the water, though both survived. 
 The comedian shared the story while promoting his debut memoir, Nine Lives, No Wives, and 69 Concubines , which features a foreword from Shaq. 
 Katt Williams has recalled the time that he and his good friend Shaquille O’Neal were involved in a jet ski accident. 
 On Friday (November 13), the comedian, who is currently busy promoting his debut memoir, Nine Lives, No Wives, and 69 Concubines , appeared on the second episode of Ice Cube and Mike Epps ' new podcast, Listen & Laugh .
 During the episode, Williams was asked about a jet ski incident involving him and Shaq — the NBA champion wrote the foreword for Katt's new book.
 Shop Ice Cube on Complex
 Shop now "Did Shaquille almost kill you on a jet ski or some shit?" Cube asked the comedian, who quickly responded: "I'm nobody. He almost killed himself running into my jet ski."
 "[The] fuck is wrong with Shaq with all that water out there?" Cube rhetorically asked, before Williams went into the details of what actually happened.
 "He was doing 40 miles an hour, because he was — you know when you ride up and go like this [mimics turning the handles of a jet ski to one side quickly] and do the splash?" he asked the hosts. "He just went too fast from too far."
 He continued: "I'm looking and he's like 20 feet away, and I'm going, 'This muthafucka can't even do the splash,' and thank goodness. But yeah, I flew. I thought Shaq was gone. I was mortified. I was in a full panic. I was already going, 'Lord, why did you save me? I can't go back without Shaq. This n***a got a game tomorrow.'"
 After some hysterical laughter among the the trio, Cube asked Williams how long it took for Shaq to come back up out of the water, and when Katt knew the NBA Hall of Famer was ok.
 "That's when I was my thinnest, so I was 5'5", 145 pounds," he replied. "So when I say I went 30 feet in the air, like — I swam for like a mile before I got back. I couldn't see him nowhere. I was just... Oh, I was mortified. Man, it was the worst experience of all times, except for the fact that we all made it."
 The new episode of Ice Cube and Mike Epps'  Listen & Laugh  podcast featuring Katt Williams is out now — watch it  here . New episodes air every Friday at 6 P.M. ET / 3 P.M. PT.
